summary: The page holds Input - Text (46 variants across Default, Inline, Condition, Tag Input, Multi-Tag, Search Tag, Table and Formula types, light and dark), Input - Dropdown Select (28 variants) and a single dark Text Area. Dropdown building blocks (option, header, table cell, lists) also live here, plus two template documentation blocks and many loose instances.

items.name: Input - Text · Default (light) states
items.use: 200×60, white fill, 1px inside border #E2EAEC (border-input-light), radius 0, padding 10, gap 10. Label 10px Open Sans Regular uppercase #545454 (text-medium), style Label/Regular/AllCaps. Value 12px: placeholder Regular #6C6C6C (text-light), filled SemiBold #313131 (text-dark). Active = border #0076DD (pando-blue). Error = fill #FFF8F9 (accent-error-red-light) + border and label #E25757 (action-red). Disabled = fill #E7E7E7 at 30% (style Opacity/E7E7E7-Light-30), border kept #E2EAEC.

items.name: .Base Input anatomy
items.use: All light types nest a .Base Input instance: vertical auto layout, padding 10, gap 10; LABEL row (horizontal, gap 2, holds label + optional red '*' #E25757); Input row (horizontal, gap 10, optional 10px icon + text). Outer variant repeats fill and border of the inner instance. Five .Base Input main components sit loose on the page (200, 250, 310×20, 310×16 sizes).
flags: Fill and border are set twice (outer variant and inner .Base Input), so overrides can disagree.
warn: Five separate .Base Input components share one name; hard to tell which is used where.
items.rec: Keep; consider one base with properties.

items.name: Text styles used
items.use: Label/Regular/AllCaps: Open Sans Regular 10, line height auto, 0 tracking, uppercase (closest type-10-regular 10/12 +0.5). Input/Regular/Normal: Regular 12 auto (closest type-12-regular 12/17). Input/Semibold/Normal: SemiBold 12 auto (type-12-semibold). Input/Regular/Italic: Italic 12. Dark: Label/Regular/AllCaps-Spacing0.5 (12 caps +0.5), Input/Regular/Spacing0.5px and Input/Semibold/Spacing0.5px (12 +0.5). Formula: 12px/Heading (SemiBold 12).
flags: Line height is 'auto' on all input styles, so no exact match to the V1 type classes (17px / 12px).
Label caps style has 0 tracking while .caps / type-10 classes use +0.5px.
Two copies of Input/Regular/Normal and Label/Semibold/AllCaps exist (one local, one library).
items.rec: Later: map to type classes when tokens are finalised.

items.name: Open state with list

flags: Table Open (4414:7025): 400-wide list is attached to a 200-wide field and overflows the variant.
warn: Dropdown parts (.Dropdown Option, .Header, .Table Cell, .Custom Add, . Toggle, .Blinking cursor, Dropdown list, Dropdown Light, .Dropdown Dark) all live on this page; may belong on a Dropdown page.
items.rec: Keep; review the dropdown parts as their own component.
